div.font:
* Every browser call goes CloudFront → WAF → API Gateway (JWT authorizer), shown as one lifeline.
* Nothing is written to Aurora until you confirm (step 5). Statement PDFs and passwords never leave the browser.
* Each reconcile request finishes within ~30 s; the app keeps calling until all new emails are processed.
* Optional: Expenses fetches a reference FX rate when a foreign-currency receipt has no PHP amount (not shown).
